title: Thought it was going to be bigger...
text: Thought it was going to be bigger.... I thought it was going to be bigger but that’s really my fault. I should’ve brought out a measuring tape and measured my other pans to compare. I wanted more of a sheet pan that I could do a sheet pan meal on or a whole lot of veggies on for large gatherings. It’s still a nice pan that I can use for other things.

product_metadata.title: Mrs. Anderson’s Baking AirWave Half Sheet Pan, Commercial Grade 19-Gauge Aluminum
features: Mrs. Anderson’s Half Sheet AirWave Pan with unique wave pattern for baking crispy, golden brown rolls, breads, cakes, cookies, and pastries every time
Heavyweight 19-gauge aluminum; reinforced beaded rim prevents warping; heat safe (to 480-degrees Fahrenheit); will outlast thousands of uses
Unique raised texture circulates hot air around and under foods for an even crisping; non-porous surface eliminates cross contamination
Won’t warp or rust; clean with a damp sponge or mild detergent as needed; do not use knives, scrapers, brushes or cutters, or place in the dishwasher
Measures 13 x 18-inches; fits Mrs. Anderson's Non-Stick Silicone Half Sheet Baking Mat (60000) and Baking Cooling Rack (43628), sold separately
description: Mrs. Anderson’s Half-Sheet AirWave Pan is a commercial-grade baking pan with a unique raised wave texture for bread making and cake baking. Hot air circulates around and under foods for an even crisping. Made from heavyweight aluminum, heat is transferred evenly so that rolls, breads, cakes, cookies, pastries and other baked goods cook to a perfect golden brown, every time. Its reinforced beaded rim prevents warping. Strong and durable, it will outlast thousands of uses at a wide range of temperatures (up to 480-degrees Fahrenheit). It’s safe to use for chilling and freezing foods, too. Simply line the Baking Pan with parchment or a baking mat, place items to be baked or frozen onto the Baking Pan, and pop it in the oven or freezer. Mrs. Anderson’s Baking Pans are durable and reusable, with a non-porous surface to eliminate the worry of cross contamination of food. They won’t warp or rust, and easily wipe clean with a damp sponge. Use a mild detergent solution as needed, and air dry. Stores away easily. This Half Sheet Baking Pan or Bun Pan (13-inches x 18-inches) is designed to perfectly fit Mrs. Anderson’s Half Sheet Baking Mat (60000) and Half Sheet Cooling Rack (43628), both sold separately. Complete instructions included. Cautions: Do not use knives, scrapers, brushes or cutters, or place in the dishwasher, as this could cause damage to the pan. Mrs. Anderson's Baking, a go-to brand for the home baker. Brought to you by HIC Harold Import Co.
